description:
Rank AI build tools by one metric computed from Vibe Shipped listings.
Use when: the user asks which AI tool has the most shipped apps, the most stated revenue, or is trending.
Do not use for: full stats without a ranking (list_tools).
Returns: tools[] ordered by the metric, with the same fields as list_tools.
Limits: by = count | revenue (total stated monthly USD) | median | trending (new listings in the last 30 days); limit 1-20. Revenue is as stated, not audited.
Example: {"by":"revenue","limit":5}
name: top_tools
title: Top AI build tools
